1: * Guided setup - Find a job by search or store area and follow a plain-language guided screen that shows what it saves and any separate step. Browsing turns nothing on. Full module settings remain.
2: * Invoices - Guided invoice branding with a rendered sample PDF that issues, numbers and emails nothing.
3: * Extras and questions - Separate guided tasks for a question per product, a question per order and a priced optional extra such as gift wrapping.
4: * Payment fees - Guided fee in plain words (name shoppers see, charge or discount) with an estimate, not a payable total. Bank transfer (BACS) rules by billing country and cart amount.
5: * Returns - Guided storewide return window with a Now and After review before applying. Approval does not refund or restock.
6: * Shipping and product tab - Guided supported shipping setup and method descriptions (no rate changes), and a shared product tab.
7: * Storefront wording - Button, price, order notes, currency symbol, sale badge and My Account Orders text. Text only; no change to conversion, taxes, prices, endpoints or permissions.
8: * Pricing help - A limited guide for an existing percentage discount, plus currency and tax guidance.
9: * Orders, documents and messages - Workspaces group order, account, document and email settings with prerequisites and help. Saving email wording sends nothing.
10: * Specialized selling - Booking label task and help for existing booking settings.
11: * Catalog and admin - Catalog display tasks; native admin toolbar category links task (prerequisites not turned on); cost fill for up to 20 selected simple products with preview and task-only Undo when checks allow; protected CSV handoff for up to 20 selected simple products (not an importer); readable old-slug history. Native bulk tools gain help, not preview or Undo.
12: * Help - Updated in-plugin help, including General and role settings. Feature and documentation pages are being updated for version 10.
13: * Security and fixes - Hardened product description and date format handling, plus inherited fixes such as the abandoned-cart %admin_email% placeholder.
14: * Compatibility - Checkout Blocks and HPOS support stays module-specific; no gateway, tax, billing or integration certification.
15: * Requirements - PHP 7.3+ on a 64-bit build with native integer hrtime(), on a maintained release supported by your WordPress and WooCommerce versions.
16: * Editions - The free edition includes the core guided tasks. Booster Plus and Booster Elite add more; frequently bought together stays Plus and Elite only.
19: * Settings backups - Export saved Booster settings and restore them after reinstalling the same edition, including general options and grouped settings.
20: * Checkout file uploads - Fix uploads with mixed-case file extensions and supported session settings. Keep staged files recoverable when an order attachment cannot be saved.
21: * Customer Return Requests - Turn on Return Requests to let signed-in customers request eligible item quantities from completed orders, follow their history and see your decision there. Verified guest access is a separate setup that needs HTTPS. Approval records your decision; it does not refund money, restock products or process a payment.
22: * Checkout Blocks - Collect supported checkout file uploads and show your Place order button text in the WooCommerce Checkout block, alongside existing supported custom fields. Existing module and edition limits still apply; this does not make every Booster option or third-party checkout compatible.
23: * Order and payment reliability - Use WooCommerce order data in affected HPOS exports and reports. Keep Booster gateway fees in sync when an eligible unpaid order changes payment method, without replacing unrelated custom fees.
24: * Understand gateway fees - See why a configured fee applies to a sample guest purchase, and check a summary of your latest up to 50 return requests. These read-only views do not change a shopper cart or predict the final checkout total. Booster Elite adds role and product facts, fee comparisons and payment/shipping rule scenarios.
25: * Hosting requirements - Requires PHP 7.3 or later on a 64-bit build with native integer hrtime() enabled. Use a maintained PHP release supported by your WordPress and WooCommerce versions.
27: * Store updates, without dashboard clutter - Receive short Booster news only on Booster settings pages. Each user can permanently dismiss a notice; store and checkout settings are unchanged.
30: * Wishlist control - Choose to keep saved products after adding them to the cart. Removal remains enabled by default, including after upgrade; disable "Remove from wishlist after adding to cart" to preserve items. Explicit removal still works.
31: * Shipping setup - Clearer guidance shows how separate category and minimum-order free-shipping methods can offer either route without duplicate free options. Existing shipping rules are not changed automatically.
32: * Security - Strengthened handling of customer-supplied product details and document processing to help keep stores protected. Updating is recommended.
33: * Branded document setup - Enter plain business details and an optional supported local logo, open a real synthetic sample, and review exact setting changes before enabling the chosen operation.
34: * Edition scope - The Light guide supports the Invoice document type, generated manually or on completed orders, with optional attachment to the customer completed-order email.
35: * Merchant control - Sample and attachment rehearsal do not send email, issue production documents or consume invoice numbers. Existing numbering, tax, advanced settings and custom templates are protected; settings undo detects later changes.
36: * Dutch continuity - Adds reviewed Dutch translations across selected core modules and the new setup guide, with English fallback outside the bounded coverage. Merchant-authored content and saved PDF templates are not translated; community and custom language overrides retain priority.
37: * Clear limits - The starter layout needs no HTML editing, but custom layouts remain in advanced settings. Sample success and attachment rehearsal do not confirm production email delivery or tax/legal compliance.
38: * Storefront continuity - Keeps setup redirects out of customer background requests after activation, so saved-list actions can work immediately.
